integrity: The threshold polynomial, determinant identity, discriminant identities, coefficient constraints, and rational Sturm root counts were recomputed from the stated equations. The source's saddle-node value is used only as a comparison after an independent algebraic derivation.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the printed ETM-3D vector field on the nonnegative parameter domain and to the initial stability interval of the origin. The certificate classification is only for centered positive-definite quadratic Lyapunov functions; translated or nonquadratic Lyapunov functions are not classified.
title: Exact global-stability threshold at the first ETM-3D saddle-node
